data.name: Venomous Stare
data.description: As a standard action, you can activate a gaze attack with a 30-foot range. This is an active gaze attack that can target a single creature within range. The target must make a Will save (DC %1). Those that fail take 1d6+ points of nonlethal damage and are fascinated until the beginning of your next turn. You can use this ability %2 times per day. This is a mind-affecting effect.|DomainScalykindDC|DomainScalykindTimes|PREVARLT:DomainScalykindLVL,2
